reason: STRENGTH: the served HR 1.05 (0.93-1.19), 541 vs 517 events, is the registry's analysis of the 3-point composite (CV death, non-fatal MI, non-fatal stroke). The extractor bound the 5-point PRIMARY (HR 0.99, 0.90-1.09) and called the served number a mismatch; that candidate is rejected for this outcome. The topic serves the 3-point definition across trials: REDUCE-IT (P53-27) is served on its 3-point key secondary, 0.74. Choosing 3-point over each trial's own primary is a topic-level endpoint decision already made on the page; it is not re-decided here. The comparator is corn oil, described as an inert comparator (registry arm 'Placebo').
